versions.changelog: Update MCP endpoint to the current Baron domain.
Correct public MCP endpoint for anonymous access

Initial release of Baron skill—helping users explore AI business ideas and prepare a reviewable business brief.

- Added ability to search public AI-driven business examples using Baron's connector.
- Supports browsing by company name, offering, or subject.
- Guides users to clarify business idea details (customer, product, delivery).
- Prepares a business brief for review and approval in Baron.
- Does not create businesses or access private/business-sensitive data.
